item.title: Noted 0.2.1
item.description:
Settings that depend on managed version control now explain themselves.

  • Auto-commit, auto-sync and the idle delay are disabled with a note until git mode is managed, with a one-click "Use Managed Mode" fix (or "Start Version Control" for projects without a repo)
  • Config keys that have no effect under the current git mode get a notice in Settings and the JSON editor, instead of silently doing nothing
  • The $schema link in .noted/config.json and theme files now points at a public URL, so external editors can validate them

item.title: Noted 0.2.0
item.description:
First public build of the native Noted.

  • Live-preview markdown editor with typography controls, focus and typewriter mode
  • Embedded terminal running Claude Code (or any CLI agent) with per-project profiles
  • Checkpoints: automatic snapshots around agent sessions, with history and diffs
  • Project-wide search, quick open, and a command palette
  • Git awareness, with an optional managed mode (commit, sync, branches, GitHub backup)
  • JSON config with a settings UI, per-project themes, and drop-in custom theme files
